title: Managed Database: billing timezone
content:
## Tier basis
Managed Database billing timezone is specified by contracted tier. Timezone used for calendar boundaries; IANA timezone string. Recurring invoice window basis; string.

| Contracted tier | Billing timezone | Billing cycle |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore | UTC | calendar month |
| Northbridge Managed Database 4 vCore | UTC | calendar month |
| Northbridge Managed Database 8 vCore | UTC | calendar month |
| Northbridge Managed Database 16 vCore | UTC | calendar month |
| Northbridge Managed Database 32 vCore | UTC | calendar month |
| Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore | UTC | calendar month |
